scope: Independent second-pass repository audit, implementation remediation, and execution of the attached production-readiness plan in a disposable local environment.

changes.details: Deleted accounts are rejected by ordinary authenticated surfaces with HTTP 410 and cannot re-enable age, memory, push, or profile state. Confirm-gated account deletion remains idempotent for retries.

The final tree follows the upstream PostgreSQL 16+ and pgvector architecture; the obsolete SQLite migration path and its tests are removed, and the full suite passes against an isolated PostgreSQL database.
The disposable visual QA user now receives an explicit future subscription expiry, so paid home journeys do not produce a false 402 entitlement failure.
The merged PostgreSQL-backed selfcheck passed schema/seed, payment idempotency, limits, PDF, practices, horoscope and webhook checks; live LLM and incomplete dev configuration remain expected skips.

Compose now requires APP_ENV, DATABASE_URL, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, and GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD instead of silently falling back to dev or known credentials. Both environment templates are blank for required secrets, and the production release gate rejects unsafe password templates.
The documented monetization startup checker no longer fails Ruff on its intentional sys.path bootstrap import.

full_pytest.result: 100% completed; one test was skipped by its declared environment condition.

backend_targeted.command: pytest tests/test_api.py tests/test_api_resilience.py tests/test_data.py tests/test_billing.py tests/test_payment_monitor.py tests/test_p1_controls.py tests/test_p2_contracts.py

frontend_static.result: Frontend build, JS syntax, provenance, asset references, cache busting, design contract, and contrast checks passed.

frontend_axe.result: Ten audited Mini App states, zero axe violations, accessibility gate passed.

frontend_lighthouse.result: Accessibility 100 and SEO 100 were observed across the audited states. Best-practices evidence was contaminated by shared rate-limit state in a combined axe/Lighthouse run; an isolated clean matrix is required before claiming a stable 100 score.

billing_jobs_observability.result: Bot FSM, Mini App actions, billing, jobs, notifications, broadcast, log stream, analytics, payment monitor, and growth tests passed.

security_resilience.result: Security regressions, safety guardrails, API resilience, rate limits, flood controls, provider compatibility, engine paths, and architecture boundaries passed.

release_gates.result: release_gate.py, check_p2_quality.py, check_p004_infrastructure.py (40 checks), documentation links, Ruff, compileall, and git diff --check passed.

dependency_hygiene.result: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high reported 0 vulnerabilities; JavaScript syntax and Python compilation passed.

backup_restore.result: PostgreSQL backup/restore contract and encrypted restore helper passed static validation. Production encryption-key custody, off-site storage permissions, real restore and rollback rehearsal remain external gates.
